business_summary: Coach A Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides dialogic organizational development services through systemic coaching in Japan and internationally. The company offers executive coaching (EC), driving corporate dynamism (DCD), three-minute coaching, and dialogue activation for innovation business execution (DAIBE) workshops; and Start Here, your Organizational Transformation (SHOT), a one-on-one coaching service to transform across the organization over a short period. It also provides Core Essentials Program, a foundational to intermediate professional coach training; COACHING CLINIC LICENSING PROGRAM, a four-day live train-the-trainer (T3) licensing program intended for individuals and organizations; and Coaching Session Evaluation Scale, a web-based system used by coaches to evaluate coaching programs. In addition, the company offers Hello, Coaching!, a coaching portal that offers coaching management tips and articles on coaching; COACH A E-Newsletter, a platform that provides information related to coaching, leadership, and transformation; and coaching for health executives/managers. Further, it provides coaching manager development services; and research and studies on leadership and organizational development. Coach A Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
